title: introspection import manifest
description: Agent-authored, normalized input for `introspection import`. introspection never parses a source tracker: the adopter's agent reads the tracker, resolves dispositions, and writes this manifest against the registered record type. The importer is pure mechanics and makes no judgment calls; record-type lifecycle and required body headings are enforced by validation, not by this schema.

record_type.description: Registered record-type key the entries are imported as (e.g. tech-debt).

id_policy.description: preserve: each entry supplies its own number (legacy IDs kept). allocate: numbers are assigned sequentially after the highest existing record number for this type.

source.description: Provenance shared by every entry. tracker_path plus an entry legacy_id derive a typed tracker source ref.

isoDateTimeString.description: Seconds-precision UTC timestamp with a Z suffix, matching the record frontmatter contract.

section.description: One markdown body section. heading is the literal markdown heading line the agent authored; the importer renders it verbatim so validation can enforce the record type required headings.

heading.description: Full markdown heading line, e.g. '## Problem'.

resolution.description: Resolution evidence for terminal statuses. The importer sets resolution.disposition equal to the entry status, so disposition is never authored separately.

number.description: Required under id_policy=preserve; rejected under id_policy=allocate.

legacy_id.description: Original tracker ID, recorded in a tracker source ref and surfaced in the import report.

status.description: Lifecycle status for the record type. Allowed values and evidence requirements are enforced by validation, not this schema.

tags.description: Optional non-machine vocabulary tags. Machine-derived tags (record/*, status/*, repo/*, visibility/*) are populated by the importer.
